Nice to meet you.
My name is Ae Watanabe.

I’d like to request an illustration of an original character.

◆Request Details
・I’ll leave the composition, pose, setting, clothing, and props entirely up to you.
・It would be helpful if the character’s layers aren’t cut off at the top, left, or right edges.

◆Reference Materials
・Hairstyle: Wolf cut
・Height: 171 cm
・Image: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QVGqQNT1FqiIzfGiAAyGhKyDZ-RdXC7T?usp=sharing

◆Intended Use
・Activities on monetized social media (headers, posts, etc.)
・Image assets for monetized video/streaming platforms (thumbnails, etc.)

◆Preferred File Format
・PSD file with the character, background, and text separated into layers

That’s all.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Dear Shaa-nee,
Nice to meet you. My name is Tono Tsukino, and I’m currently preparing to become a VTuber.
I’ve had the pleasure of viewing your work, and I was captivated by your artistic style, color palette, composition, and the way you depict characters illuminated by light in dark settings. I’d love for you to draw something for me, which is why I’m submitting this request.

【Request Details】 
An illustration of Tono Tsukino

【Intended Use】 
○ Use in images and videos on a YouTube channel with potential for monetization
○ Use in images and videos on social media
○ Use in printed materials for personal viewing (not for commercial use)

【About Tono Yuzuki】
○ A rabbit born on the moon
○ Genderless
○ Always accompanied by their partner, “Shirasu”
○ Currently infiltrating Earth as a human, studying and working to learn about the planet

【About Shirasu】
○ Spends time with Tono Yuzuki as their partner
○ Can change to various sizes
○ Uses various methods of movement, such as hopping, flying, perching on heads, and rolling

【Appearance Reference】
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z4Nd5R2-4L_MUDcY5SZ6_o8COyr0H9Zr

【Requests】
○ Since this character has no gender, I would appreciate it if you could refrain from depicting female breasts
○ Please depict my ears as rabbit ears only
○ Please ensure that the head (including ears and hair) is not cut off from the frame as much as possible
○ I particularly like Syaa-nee-sama’s works that feature scenes illuminated by light in dark settings, such as the examples below, so I’d like to request a similar atmosphere

https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/68
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/66
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/64
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/55

However, the examples above are merely suggestions, so feel free to make changes as you see fit.
I’d be happy if you could enjoy drawing this, Syaaaaneeeyona-sama.

[Preferred Delivery Formats]
If any of the following options are possible for you, please use them:
・PNG or PSD with a background
・PSD with separate layers for the background and character
・PNG with a transparent background

I apologize for bothering you during such a busy time, but I would appreciate it if you could consider this request.
Thank you in advance.

Tono Yozuki

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z4Nd5R2-4L_MUDcY5SZ6_o8COyr0H9Zr

Dear Shaa-nee,

She is one of the participants in a “death game,” and her weapon is a rifle, which she hides under her skirt.
